summary: GitHub Copilot Free grants every developer 2,000 code completions and 50 chat requests per month at no cost, with model choice between Anthropic's Claude 3.5 Sonnet and OpenAI's GPT-4o. It works in VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains IDEs, and on GitHub.com.
claim_steps: Sign in to GitHub with your personal account.
Visit github.com/features/copilot/plans and select the Free plan.
Install the Copilot extension in your editor (VS Code, JetBrains, or Visual Studio).
Start completing and chatting — 2,000 completions + 50 chats refresh monthly.
